environment: Existing staging testnet; Tokyo browser, APAC home, Hong Kong Gateway, Console and custody-role databases.

sourceCommits.custody: Same previously verified role versions in every measured group

limitations: Three new wallets per arm; baseline, candidate, repeated baseline. This does not establish a latency guarantee.
The SDK is fixed in all arms, with early preflights and no HTTP request interception.
Funding and blockchain confirmation are excluded. Interaction-inclusive registration is retained separately.
Three discarded warm-up wallets precede each group of three measured wallets. No controlled cold-start claim is made.

Gateway, Runtime and Console change between arms. The candidate consolidates setup, respond and finalization reads, and admits Console registration mutations within their write transactions. SDK, custody, database bindings and placement remain fixed.
D1 totals exclude custody-role databases and calls pending when the response was captured. SQL statements are counted separately.
Whole Worker invocation CPU and wall times can include background work. Overlapping spans must not be added.
